source.note: 1999-00 SPx Basketball hobby product. The 120-card flagship checklist remains one collector-facing VCS Base ProductSet. All TCDB-listed pack insert families and both full parallels are modeled. Winning Materials autograph variants are split from the ordinary Winning Materials checklist so the published 1:252 odds are not incorrectly applied to the signed cards. The five-copy Michael Jordan Master Collection redemption is also modeled as a pack outcome from sealed-box documentation even though TCDB does not list it as a normal insert checklist.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: Hobby: 4 cards per pack, 18 packs per box.
decisions.collectorChecklistIntegrity: Base #1-120 remains one VCS Base ProductSet. Cards #91-120 are recognized RCs with card-specific serial/autograph metadata, but VCS intentionally flattens range/card-specific base scarcity so completion percentage reflects the full 120-card set.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: True RC status is taken from the TCDB rookie-card index. Only verified base RCs get RC appended to Player.
decisions.cleanPlayerNames: Player contains only the clean card subject name plus verified RC when applicable. AU, MEM, SN/PR, VAR and related collector annotations stay in Variant.
decisions.oddsPlacement: Verified pack odds live only on ProductSets. No card Variant contains set-wide 1:N odds.
decisions.parallelOdds: Radiance is SN100 and Spectrum is SN1, but no reliable standalone pack rates were found. Their oddsPerPack values remain null rather than inferring odds from print runs.
decisions.winningMaterialsModeling: The eight ordinary Winning Materials cards are a 1:252 ProductSet. Michael Jordan WM1a (AU/MEM/SN23) and Karl Malone WM2a (AU/MEM/SN32) are separated into Winning Materials Autographs with oddsPerPack null because the 1:252 rate applies to the ordinary Winning Materials insert family, not a verified autograph rate.
decisions.redemptionModeling: One Michael Jordan Master Collection Redemption card is modeled as its own one-card insert with PR5 metadata. No per-pack odds are invented for the five-copy redemption.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until images, pricing and any null pack odds intended for gameplay are reviewed.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete flagship checklist #1-120. #91-120 are recognized RCs and retain source AU/SN metadata in Variant; all 120 have equal VCS Base availability for collector completion integrity.

productSets.name: Radiance
productSets.notes: Full 120-card parallel, SN100. Published pack rate not verified; no inferred odds.

productSets.name: Spectrum
productSets.notes: Full 120-card one-of-one parallel, SN1. Published pack rate not verified; no inferred odds.

productSets.name: Winning Materials
productSets.notes: Eight ordinary memorabilia cards, inserted 1:252 packs. WM3 and WM7 do not exist. The two autograph variants are modeled separately.

productSets.name: Winning Materials Autographs
productSets.notes: Michael Jordan WM1a AU/MEM/SN23 and Karl Malone WM2a AU/MEM/SN32. No standalone autograph pack rate is encoded.

productSets.name: Michael Jordan Master Collection Redemption
productSets.notes: Pack-inserted Michael Jordan Master Collection redemption; sealed-box documentation reports only five total redemption cards. No unsupported per-pack rate is inferred.
